Month groups; names and hints from the dictionary and 08 BR-TEXT-19 (missing keys registered as package defaults); amounts per BR-TEXT-10 for in-app H5 (trailing zeros dropped, + for credits, ASCII - before ¥, integer math via @couli/money); dates per BR-TEXT-11; balance after may be negative; withdraw-paid summary with fee and tax lines; order / withdraw rows open via bridge nav.open, masked and REWARD rows not clickable, ACCOUNT_CLOSED hidden; pull-to-refresh reads only the first page, one request in flight at a time, refresh failure keeps rows with an error and retry, 10405 never replayed and all automatic refetches disabled. Rule tests by Codex in three calls plus one exception round (LIST#6 only); Claude spec-test review r3 pass; red on the test machine (red/3: 32 red, 0 problems). Implementation by Opus 5.5 in three rounds; test machine verify-fast/4 and browser/3 green. Review: Codex (approvals id 27 / 34 / 36). Written by hand.
